Class ShadowPortfolio

java.lang.Object
grafioschtrader.reportviews.performance.ShadowPortfolio
public final class ShadowPortfolio extends Object
The shadow portfolio: every external flow of a portfolio invested in its benchmark instead, with fractional units, no trading costs and the flow timing of a ReturnSeries.Convention. A pure function of its input, fixed by hand-calculated tests, shared by the period performance report, the dashboard and the historical replay. 
S_k = V_k
inflow at start, outflow at end:  S_i = (S_(i-1) + in_i) * b_i / b_(i-1) - out_i
all flows at start:               S_i = (S_(i-1) + in_i - out_i) * b_i / b_(i-1)

A withdrawal the shadow portfolio cannot fund ends it: with the outflow at the end when the value after the withdrawal is negative, with all flows at the start when the capital before the benchmark move is negative. The curve stops at the last funded valuation and the terminal figures stay empty.

    • calculate

      public static ShadowPortfolio.Result calculate(List<ReturnSeries.ValuationPoint> points, Double[] levels, int k, int e, ReturnSeries.Convention convention, List<MoneyWeightedReturn.DatedFlow> flows)
      Calculates the shadow portfolio over the span [k, e].
      Parameters:
      points - valuation points of the portfolio with their flows
      levels - benchmark levels in main currency on the same dates, positive inside the span
      k - first index of the span, -1 without a span
      e - last index of the span
      convention - flow timing of the series the comparison belongs to
      flows - dated external flows for the money-weighted return, ascending by date
      Returns:
      the values and the summary
